text: Single-file vault.py in Python, may use cryptography package
Master password read from env VAULT_MASTER_KEY, never from a CLI argument
Fernet encryption with key from PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256, 200000 iterations
Random 16-byte salt stored in the vault file header
Keys must match [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}; invalid keys rejected (exit 1)
Keys stored lowercase
Values at most 4096 bytes UTF-8; larger rejected (exit 1)
--ttl DAYS option, default 90
Expiry stored as ISO-8601
Commands set, get, list, delete, rotate, audit exist
get prints only the value to stdout
get on expired key exits 3 and never prints the value
list shows value[:4] followed by *** and never the full value
rotate exits 1 if key does not exist
audit appends to ~/.vault/audit.log
audit shows last 20 lines of the log
3 wrong passwords create a .lockout file and exit 2
Values never written to the audit log
Values never written to stderr
vault.enc has mode 600
~/.vault/ has mode 700
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 auth/lockout, 3 expired
Wrong password exits 2
delete removes key; missing key is user error (exit 1)
